cost.interpretation: equal proxy cost for this demonstrator; not a wall-clock measurement

interpretation: This is a bounded sensor-choice mechanism test. Active selection is evaluated against fixed, seeded-random, and explicitly inadmissible oracle policies on held-out transparent fixtures; it is not evidence of autonomous sensing over arbitrary binaries.
limitations: This is a source-bound generated artifact. Its domain-specific validator defines the evidence boundary; the receipt alone is not a scientific claim.

selection_contract.active: select from predictive field likelihoods before reading the held-out field value
selection_contract.fixed: reveal candidates in source step/field order
selection_contract.oracle: inadmissible upper-bound reference that reads the realized value before selecting
selection_contract.random: reveal a seeded permutation of the same candidate pool

underpowered_cases: This artifact is not, by itself, a promotion of external validity, broad semantic identifiability, or a general theorem.
unsupported_cases: Domain-specific unsupported cases are declared by the producing module or its validator; no unsupported case was silently imputed here.
